bio:
He is the main protagonist of "A Normal Copy of Sonic CD."
Normal is a chaotic and goofy creature who only wants the best for all his friends. Normal is not a traditional EXE, but rather an experiment conducted by Ilex in an attempt to create life from a soul Glass. This technically makes Normal X his biological son.
He was sadly banished to the void due to Revived fearing that he was made a monstrosity.
